The container loads all variables from the external ConfigMap app-env through envFrom, and that ConfigMap can set MANAGEMENT_SERVER_PORT=8081, which would make both probes return 200 because the probe groups are auto-enabled on Kubernetes. Whether the probes reach Actuator therefore depends on that ConfigMap.
